reason: User input is hashed via MessageDigest before reaching the HTML encoder. The data flow shows: user param -> valuesList -> bar -> input (bytes) -> MD hash -> hash result -> encodeForHTML. Since the hash neutralizes the user input before encoding, no XSS can occur.
